description: What one block on an agent lane represents, in the one vocabulary every lane surface shares. The kind is always painted twice — a decorative glyph and a localized WORD — because an icon alone is not information a screen-reader reader can use. The set is deliberately small and transport-neutral: a host maps its own vocabulary (a plan step, a tool call, a room message, a review gate, a delegation) onto these five values and TmAgentLanes stays backend-free. An unknown value (a member from a newer backend) renders the neutral glyph and the Task word, so a stale contract can never paint a wrong kind.

members.name: Task
members.description: A piece of work assigned to the agent — a plan step, a turn, a task. The default.

members.name: Tool
members.description: A tool call the agent made (a lookup, a write, a command).

members.name: Message
members.description: A message the agent produced or received.

members.name: Review
members.description: A review or approval gate — the block a reader usually has to act on.

members.name: Handoff
members.description: A transfer of the work to another agent; the lane surface draws it with a handoff arrow.
